title: Moebius's Eden
content: Has anyone else been in this setting? I'm calling it Moebius's Eden. It's characterised by beautiful nature, often populated by socially active children. Often, though, the nature is physically impossible, with floating islands or "spherical space." I believe these dreams are induced (in me at least) by playing Sky: CotL, but I'm curious as to whether anyone else has them, because I find these settings gorgeous. Please also note whether you've played Sky before if you reply to this.
